rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-043 CAUSES PSY-086

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-061 CAUSES PSY-116

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-058 ENABLES PSY-059

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-108 CAUSES PSY-109

rowAccounts.proposition: SOC-031 CAUSES PSY-024

rowAccounts.proposition: BIO-001 CAUSES PSY-057

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-019 CAUSES PSY-101

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-044 CAUSES PSY-110

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-043 CAUSES PSY-110

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-076 CAUSES PSY-045

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-077 CAUSES PSY-113
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Cultural authority legitimacy and individual credibility are distinct levels; credential cue is not randomly assigned cultural norm.

rowAccounts.proposition: CUL-082 CAUSES PSY-097
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Durable collective narrative centrality and an individual's multidimensional identification require realized exposure, interpretation and component specification. Current mediated-segment wording is generic, not an identified mechanism.

rowAccounts.proposition: ENV-039 CAUSES PSY-057

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-012 CAUSES PSY-057
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Reuse INF-F03 approved revision-proposal-only finding: ambiguity and cognitive-processing demand require task/proxy alignment; no replacement implemented.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-017 CAUSES PSY-084
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Framing can alter risky decisions through reference/representation; the canonical endpoint is loss-versus-gain sensitivity, not choice itself. Framework sources do not isolate a changed loss-aversion parameter.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-027 CAUSES PSY-114
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Objective methodological evidence quality is not pretested subjective argument strength.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-034 CAUSES PSY-113
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Traceability permits checking; discovered poor source or failure may reduce credibility.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-058 CAUSES PSY-009
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Communicated severity is distinct from perceived severity; native references are a behavior-design framework and information-threat policy, not exact trial evidence.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-056 CAUSES PSY-010
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Information about efficacy differs from belief in efficacy; original framework/policy sources do not test the exact target.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-068 CAUSES PSY-119
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Material omission is RDS ratio over a reference universe; perceptual sufficiency requires recipient detection/knowledge.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-067 CAUSES PSY-063
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Current mechanism describes accuracy of causal beliefs, but PSY-063 is confidence in a specified causal proposition; veracity, acceptance, strength and calibration remain distinct.

rowAccounts.proposition: INF-073 CAUSES PSY-076
rowAccounts.originalRationale: External recommendation detail and internal action-plan specificity are distinct analytic units; uptake, comprehension and opportunity are required.

rowAccounts.proposition: INS-047 CAUSES PSY-108
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Actual mandate scope, awareness and perceived legitimacy differ; algorithm/human monitoring identity is not scope.

rowAccounts.proposition: INS-051 CAUSES PSY-022
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Institutional impartiality can be experienced as procedural fairness, but current sources are governance indicators and perception regressions rather than an independently identified institution-to-person effect.

rowAccounts.proposition: INS-075 CAUSES PSY-022
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Differential enforcement can be noticed as unfair, but differential treatment may be judged justified under relevant standards; neither source isolates this objective source.

rowAccounts.proposition: INS-079 CAUSES PSY-023
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Information about corruption can alter trust, but real corruption prevalence, trust and legitimacy are distinct; cited sources do not establish the exact negative legitimacy claim.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-002 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Attitude strength changes the consequence of valence; stronger negative attitude need not increase positive behavioral intention. Legacy record itself says moderation was flattened.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-004 CAUSES PSY-001
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Retain context-dependent sign in proposal; expectancy-value formula is not experimental causality. Outcome probability and valence must refer to the same salient outcome.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-005 CAUSES PSY-001
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Outcome value is not action attitude; no causal inference from using valuation as a component of an attitude estimator.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-012 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ease/control and capability are not one dimension; the self-efficacy experimental meta-analysis cannot automatically validate every external-constraint PBC component.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-008 CAUSES PSY-041
rowAccounts.originalRationale: PSY-008 permits beneficial outcomes; a generic positive fear effect is too broad. Likelihood/threat and elicited fear must be independently distinguished.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-009 CAUSES PSY-041
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Perceived severity is distinct from fear, and strong fear messages do not isolate the severity appraisal causally.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-010 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Protective-response usefulness can support intention; content-based meta-analysis and broad theory do not identify all latent efficacy contrasts.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-016 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Specific norm perceptions can precede intentions, but assigned norm discrepancy and adolescent behavior syntheses do not establish isolated descriptive-norm→commitment effects.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-017 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Perceived approval and intention are related, but broad subjective-norm manipulations can bundle descriptive/approval and personal attitudes.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-022 CAUSES PSY-023
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Procedural-justice packages and organizational justice correlations support a research direction, not uniform causal effects of every fairness facet on rightfulness.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-019 CAUSES PSY-054
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Functional perceived support can buffer stress-related outcomes, while integration measures often show main effects; these are not identical causal routes into perceived stress appraisal.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-016 CAUSES SOC-001
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Norm-feedback experiments can influence individual behavior, but perceived norms are not independently randomized and group prevalence requires explicit aggregation.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-024 CAUSES PSY-020
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Perceived rejection and low belonging share content; randomized ostracism changes both but does not independently randomize the perceived-exclusion mediator.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-035 CAUSES PSY-033
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Current volition-to-self-endorsed-regulation mechanism is plausible but overlapping wording and pooled SDT correlations do not isolate independent causal change.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-036 CAUSES PSY-032
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Competence and intrinsic interest are related, but feedback/choice manipulations affect multiple experiences rather than randomizing competence alone.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-029 CAUSES PSY-027
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Retain current NON_MONOTONIC context dependence, but review cited evidence for perceived difficulty causing commitment rather than commitment moderating difficulty-to-performance.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-040 CAUSES PSY-026
rowAccounts.originalRationale: The current mechanism is already inaction-qualified. Preserve it, but explicit source findings distinguish action versus inaction regret and largely associative evidence.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-028 CAUSES PSY-077
rowAccounts.originalRationale: A clear goal supplies a comparison criterion, but Harkin experimentally promotes monitoring rather than identifying goal-specificity-to-monitoring intensity.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-042 CAUSES PSY-058
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Anxiety is associated with poorer working-memory task performance and experimentally induced anxiety can impair tasks; task capacity/performance are not the entire available-resource construct.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-057 CAUSES PSY-058
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Occupied resources and available resources can be complementary descriptions under a fixed-capacity model; that does not establish independent temporal causation.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-070 CAUSES PSY-071
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Habit-strength composites include automaticity items and the definition already specifies reduced deliberation. Contemporaneous composite/subscale correlation cannot establish independent cause.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-072 CAUSES PSY-071
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Stronger cue-response links may facilitate particular initiation features, but whole PSY-071 automaticity is multidimensional and may share priming/latency indicators with the source.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-075 CAUSES PSY-072
rowAccounts.originalRationale: An assigned if-then planning operation is not a measured increase in PSY-075 strength. Cue accessibility and cue-response association are different mediator candidates; performance does not identify both.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-077 CAUSES PSY-078
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Monitoring can change perceived-current information before corrective behavior. The RDS then recalculates; later progress toward a target is not the same operation. For a signed discrepancy, approach to zero is not universal NEGATIVE polarity.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-079 CAUSES PSY-043
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Emotion-regulation capacity is not habitual strategy use or instructed reappraisal. Cited dispositional psychopathology synthesis and ERQ validation do not isolate available capacity→anger.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-080 CONSTRAINS PSY-058
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Attention-control capacity and WM availability are related but cannot be equated with task performance; CONSTRAINS plus POSITIVE requires explicit protective-capacity interpretation.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-097 CAUSES PSY-096
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Centrality is already a component of PSY-097 profile; same-time profile→centrality may be definitional/measurement overlap rather than independent cause.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-100 CAUSES PSY-115
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Global threat may promote defensive processing, but counterarguing is exact thought count/quality; affirmation→message acceptance does not identify threat→counterarguing.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-101 CAUSES PSY-043
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Identity threat, identification, perceived injustice and anger are distinct. Collective-action meta-analyses do not isolate this exact threat→anger proposition.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-097 CAUSES SOC-034
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Person-level identification and group cooperation prevalence require contribution/opportunity aggregation, not collective-action intent or violent sacrifice.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-109 CAUSES PSY-115
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Negative cognition contributes to measured reactance; treating the composite as an independent cause of its counterargument component risks circularity.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-110 CAUSES PSY-027
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Moralized positions can accompany stronger action commitment, but reviewed work concerns attitude conviction and collective participation, not isolated goal attachment.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-109 CAUSES SOC-001
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Reactance is not universally positive for any specified behavior's group prevalence; opposition may reduce advocated behavior.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-113 CAUSES PSY-003
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Prior opinion and involvement change source-cue effects. Perceived-source manipulation checks and attitude outcomes do not automatically identify belief confidence causality.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-115 CAUSES PSY-003
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Counterarguments against a message and confidence in one's original belief have different referents. One negative generic edge can encode the wrong sign.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-117 CAUSES PSY-115
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Resistance motivation and generated counterarguments can be related but successful resistance is not a direct motivation measure.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-121 CAUSES PSY-054
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Neuroticism is canonically a tendency toward negative affect/stress sensitivity; correlations with stress can partly share content. Kotov examines diagnoses, not exact current appraisal.

rowAccounts.proposition: PSY-130 CAUSES PSY-119
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Trait/situational desire for closure may alter search thresholds, but stopping does not establish judged adequacy.

rowAccounts.proposition: SOC-001 CAUSES PSY-016
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Actual prevalence may inform perceived norm only when sampled/communicated; displayed survey statistics are not the actual group changing.

rowAccounts.proposition: SOC-002 CAUSES PSY-017
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Publicly expressed approval may inform perceived approval, but private beliefs and expression are not identical; audience and salience select whose views are seen.

rowAccounts.proposition: TEC-037 CAUSES PSY-118
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Objective reliability must be experienced/attributed before trust; automation reliance is not specific-source epistemic generalization.

rowAccounts.proposition: TEC-062 CAUSES PSY-077
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Visible tracking is an affordance; deliberate attended comparison is the Psychological target. NIST AI RMF is not exact behavioral efficacy evidence.

rowAccounts.proposition: TEC-089 CAUSES PSY-113
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Synthetic-versus-real face category is not independently manipulated fidelity or source credibility for a claim.

rowAccounts.proposition: Repeated encounter with the same factual statement/headline can alter subsequently rated belief confidence in controlled adult online/laboratory tasks. Ordinary judgment tasks often show increases; extreme implausibility, explicit veracity cues and initial accuracy focus bound the claim. No universal monotonic sign, transfer to arbitrary content, calibrated truth or behavior is asserted. Extreme implausibility is not a universal exclusion: a later five-presentation/100-point-scale experiment found higher ratings while ratings remained below midpoint.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Previously presented fake-news headlines received higher accuracy ratings; no generalized monotonic dose function established.

rowAccounts.proposition: Present a specified claim again in a bounded exposure protocol
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Arrange a further encounter with the same specified claim/headline under an explicit presentation protocol. Identity records presentation only, not belief, truth, efficacy or permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Present a concise explanatory refutation of a specified false claim
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Present a short message identifying a particular false claim and supplying a corrected account with reasons/source context. Treat the message protocol as a bundle; identity implies no efficacy or component effect.

rowAccounts.proposition: Assign a response-contingent termination rule in a bounded aversive-noise task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Configure the declared button/cue protocol so a qualifying response terminates the laboratory noise episode. A researcher operation identity only; no efficacy, ethical permission or real-world stress protection implied. Comparator and session-level variations belong to scoped effects.

rowAccounts.proposition: Withhold subsequent virtual ball passes after initial participation in a bounded inclusion task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Configure computer-controlled co-players to stop passing to the participant after a declared initial inclusion sequence. This operation identity is not ostracism efficacy, a social-tie edit, a PSYWERX Relationship edit or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Display a comparative own, perceived-peer and measured-peer behavior feedback panel
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Present a specified individual's report alongside their estimate of a declared reference group and an appropriately sourced estimate for that group. One comparative display operation; not a package of independent treatments. No accuracy, efficacy, behavior benefit or calibration promise.

rowAccounts.proposition: Offer a bounded choice among specified task alternatives
rowAccounts.originalRationale: A responsible task provider offers the performer a bounded set of specified task alternatives and lets them select an option. The operation does not promise interest, autonomy, efficacy, fidelity, learning or practitioner permission. Option selection is not unrestricted action choice, partner-link revision, or a change to a PSYWERX Relationship.

rowAccounts.proposition: Perform a specified cyclic-sighing breathing sequence
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Deliberate performance of a specified repeated two-stage inhalation/prolonged-exhalation sequence. Identity only: not generic slow/coherent/box breathing, not a clinical prescription, efficacy claim or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Present a specified audiovisual film excerpt for attentive viewing
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Deliberate presentation of a specified audiovisual excerpt with viewing instructions. Clip/language/version identified in each scoped effect; identity does not promise an emotional response, scientific fidelity, diagnosis, or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Overlay a specified instructional visual cue on task-relevant material
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Add a non-content visual marker/highlight/spotlight identifying a specified relevant region in instructional material. Exact cue modality, schedule and region belong in scope. Identity promises no attention, load or learning effect and grants no permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Practice a specified n-back updating task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Repeatedly perform a specified n-back comparison/updating task under a declared stimulus and training protocol. Identity does not imply generalized memory capacity, intelligence, transfer or permission. Single/dual/adaptive configurations require effect-specific scope or distinct identity review if materially different.

rowAccounts.proposition: Practice free recall of specified previously studied material without feedback
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Attempt retrieval of specified previously studied material under a declared cue, without corrective feedback during the practice interval. Identity does not promise retention, accurate knowledge, transfer, confidence, efficacy or practitioner permission. Study/test schedule and cue belong in effect scope.

rowAccounts.proposition: Provide specified confirming feedback after a lineup response
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Deliver a specified message confirming a participant's identification or lineup-rejection response after it is made. The identity describes the research operation only: no accuracy, confidence benefit, efficacy, truthful validation or practitioner permission is implied.

rowAccounts.proposition: Repeat a selected behavior in response to a declared recurring cue
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Deliberately repeat a specified selected behavior when a declared routine/time/context cue occurs. Identity describes practice, not acquired habit, automaticity, benefit, efficacy or practitioner permission. Actual enactment and context stability must be checked; outcome-dependent duration is not identity.

rowAccounts.proposition: Form a specified if-then cue-response plan
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Encode a declared anticipated situation and intended response in an if-then plan. Identity promises no enactment, associative strengthening, automaticity, efficacy, permission or enduring habit; does not include coping planning or mental contrasting by default.

rowAccounts.proposition: Prompt scheduled checking and recording of specified goal progress
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask a person to attend to and record progress against an explicitly specified goal on declared occasions. Identity specifies a prompt, not compliance, efficacy, permission, gap reduction or recommendation.

rowAccounts.proposition: Practice a specified go/no-go response-withholding task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Repeatedly present specified go and no-go cues with task instructions to respond or withhold respectively. Stimuli, proportion, timing and adaptivity belong to the protocol. Identity promises no general inhibition, behavioral benefit, efficacy or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Generate a positive personal future episode and display its event cue during a specified choice task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask a participant to elaborate a realistic positive future event and display a cue to that event during a specified decision. Valence, event timing and cue content are operation parameters; identity promises no efficacy, patience, trait change or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Preselect a specified option while permitting explicit switching or decline
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Designate a particular option as initially selected in a bounded choice interface, with declared alternatives and switching/declining procedure. No preference change, efficacy, endorsement, permission or welfare benefit is implied.

rowAccounts.proposition: Reflect and write about a personally important value
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Invite a consenting participant to select and explain a personally important value in a specified writing task. Not generic praise, group superiority, efficacy, trait change or practitioner permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Voluntarily write a specified counterattitudinal statement under a declared choice protocol
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask a consenting participant to write a statement inconsistent with a previously specified attitude under declared choice conditions. Operation does not guarantee discomfort, attitude change or real-world persuasion.

rowAccounts.proposition: Recall and describe an experienced shared crisis within a specified research task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Invite a consenting participant to recall and describe a specified previously experienced collective crisis. This does not create a crisis, induce trauma deliberately, guarantee fusion or imply recommendation.

rowAccounts.proposition: Present a specified high-control health recommendation
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Deliver a declared pressure/no-choice health-message script. Content, derogation, politeness and restoration wording must be specified; identity is not efficacy or permission.

rowAccounts.proposition: Set an action-feedback delay distribution in a bounded task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Configure specified keypress-to-feedback timing and learning history. Does not itself imply agency change, real control loss or behavioral consequences.

rowAccounts.proposition: Instruct imagining another person's perspective using available information
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask a consenting participant to imagine another's viewpoint using currently available information. Not conversation, new information provision, capacity training package or efficacy promise.

rowAccounts.proposition: Provide feedback on declared judgment accuracy in a specified task
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask for judgment confidence/prediction and provide declared accuracy/calibration feedback in a specified task. Not generic praise, false confirming feedback or automatic skill/behavior benefit.

rowAccounts.proposition: Forewarn of an upcoming persuasive appeal
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Disclose that a specified upcoming message attempts persuasion, with declared topic/timing. Not a refutation/inoculation package or automatic resistance.

rowAccounts.proposition: Supply previously omitted opposing decision arguments
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Provide the previously unavailable countervailing arguments for a specified decision after initial information. Not falsehood correction, invented completeness or guaranteed sufficient understanding.

rowAccounts.proposition: Conduct a specified behavioral test of an uncertainty prediction
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Under a qualified protocol, state an uncertainty-related prediction and compare it with the observed outcome of a specified consensual behavioral test. This operation is not the entire twelve-session therapy course and promises no efficacy.

rowAccounts.proposition: Instruct specified outgoing behavior for a bounded interval
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Ask a consenting participant to enact specified bold/talkative/assertive social behaviors for a declared interval. Not group assignment, friendship creation, digital coaching package or promise of trait change.

rowAccounts.proposition: Same factual headline/claim repeated within a declared initial-task and test protocol; target is belief confidence in that claim, not its objective accuracy. Ordinary initial tasks can increase rated truth; accuracy-focused instructions, veracity cues and implausibility can attenuate or remove detected effects. No arbitrary dose-response. Extreme implausibility is not a universal exclusion: a later five-presentation/100-point-scale experiment found higher ratings while ratings remained below midpoint.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Previously presented fake-news headlines received higher accuracy ratings; no generalized monotonic dose function established.

rowAccounts.proposition: For previously exposed short false claims in the reported adult US MTurk protocol, explanatory refutation versus plain false-tag retraction reduced belief in the same false proposition at approximately one week. This comparison is not a universal effect of any correction or a one-day benefit.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Refutation produced lower false-claim belief than plain retraction in the previously exposed conditions; baseline-adjusted change supported the contrast.

rowAccounts.proposition: In the specified healthy young-adult aversive-noise task, a response-contingent termination protocol versus its pseudo-yoked noncontingent comparator increased perceived control OVER THAT TASK. Not a universal effect of control availability, not specifically a validated measure of stressor controllability, not chronic agency or psychological safety.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Contingent-response group rated task control higher; effect cannot isolate experienced success, instruction, timing and task contingency as independent components.

rowAccounts.proposition: Research question whether the same contingent-control protocol alters expected ineffectiveness of one's actions (PSY-015). Current evidence measures feelings of helplessness, not the exact expectation; direction remains UNKNOWN.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: In the accessed young-adult virtual ball-game protocols, stopping passes after initial inclusion can increase immediate feelings of being ignored/excluded compared with continued inclusion. The claim is about perceived exclusion DURING THAT GAME, not chronic rejection, actual friendship loss, physiological stress or future behavior. Age-six non-detection is explicitly outside this proposed adult scope.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Exclusion condition reported higher ignored/excluded ratings than inclusion. FoMO and attachment-anxiety moderation terms were not detected; they were measured, not randomized. Adults reported greater feeling ignored in the ostracism condition. No inference to attention performance or whole need profile is imported.

rowAccounts.proposition: Research question: comparative feedback about own, perceived-peer and measured-peer drinking changes the exact PSY-016 prevalence/frequency judgment. Accessed abstracts support a norm-measure research direction but do not resolve volume-versus-frequency dimension, comparator detail or exact direction. Do not claim universal reduction or calibrated correctness.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Providing two content-aligned, intermediate-difficulty homework options rather than assigning a yoked option can increase unit-end self-reported INTEREST/ENJOYMENT OF THAT HOMEWORK among grades 9–12 students in comparable short, teacher-supervised instructional units. No universal all-task, culture, age, trait or long-term effect.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Students reported higher homework interest/enjoyment under choice. This is not proof that increased perceived autonomy independently mediated the effect.

rowAccounts.proposition: Question: does specified cyclic sighing change current anxiety intensity beyond a matched attention/control condition in comparable screened adults? No universal decrease or clinical/trait benefit is asserted.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Question: can specified sadness-eliciting clips change current sadness relative to specified neutral clips in comparable French-speaking young adult viewers? Exact clip list and same-item contrast remain unresolved; no universal film effect.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Review reports effective sadness and several other discrete-emotion inductions; happiness induction was not significant.

rowAccounts.proposition: Specified instructional visual cues in multimedia learning; evidence includes varied cue forms and learner populations. Exact occupied-resource measure and cue-specific contrast unresolved.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: N-back updating practice in the healthy-adult studies; exact variant, comparator, availability measurement and persistence require further extraction.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Intermediate WM transfer improved immediately after training.

rowAccounts.proposition: After7min initial reading of specified short prose, one7min title-cued free-recall attempt without feedback versus7min restudy can increase probability of retrieving that prose's idea units under the same title cue at2days or1week among comparable18–24year-old undergraduates. Five-minute tests explicitly excluded from signed increase.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Initial retrieval yielded higher delayed idea-unit recall than matched-time restudy.

rowAccounts.proposition: Specified confirming post-identification feedback in video/photolineup experiments; exact current-versus-retrospective confidence estimand and comparator unresolved.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Selected daily behaviors repeated at declared recurring cues; exact control-adjusted causal change in context-specific learned habit propensity not established by current source extraction.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Specified if-then plan in verbal cue-response tasks; exact priming measurement/controls and transfer beyond task unresolved.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Specified goal-progress prompts versus specified comparator, with actual attended checking/recording measured. Current evidence pools heterogeneous intervention protocols; exact prompt implementation and attention-versus-frequency contrast require extraction.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Monitoring frequency increased on average across randomized protocols.

rowAccounts.proposition: Repeated specified GNG practice in healthy adults; exact protocol, independent inhibitory-control measurement and active comparator required. No whole-capacity or durable transfer assertion from heterogeneous task scores.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: See scoped mixed/insufficient findings; no isolated supportive contrast asserted.

rowAccounts.proposition: Positive personal future-episode cue displayed during specified hypothetical monetary intertemporal choices in studied adults; no uncued persistence or general trait claim. Exact canonical discount-rate/curve specification remains unresolved.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Cue-present future thinking reduced local discounting relative to recent-event control; relevant event content matters.

rowAccounts.proposition: Specified preselected option versus active-choice/alternative-default comparator in declared choice domain; independent subjective preference measure needed.
rowAccounts.originalRationale: Positive average default-choice effect; substantial heterogeneity across domains and mechanisms.

rowAccounts.proposition: Important personal-value reflection in studied individual writing protocols; not group praise or pride-recall equivalence.

rowAccounts.originalRationale: Existing INF-F03 feature-scope issue recurs for attitude certainty versus Attitude Strength. No whole-profile effect candidate retained; no AE04 expansion or production repair. PSY-F03 procedural fairness versus multidimensional Perceived Fairness presents the same unresolved feature-scope problem; no effect retained on the whole profile. PSY-F07 DomainKnowledge amount/organization raises the same feature-scope boundary; selected recall/concept-map score cannot imply whole-profile improvement. No production repair. F08 automaticity facets and reinforcement probability/value profiles also require exact normalized scope; no whole-profile effects retained. F11 social-identification profile includes centrality/solidarity/satisfaction/self-stereotyping; one component cannot imply uniform profile change. REL-PSY-065 remains retype-review only. F13 researcher expertise/trustworthiness and face trust ratings cannot automatically reduce/increase every credibility dimension. New whole-profile effect not retained; existing human-governed INF-F03 scoped claim remains unchanged. F14 same-PEACH-dataset facet reanalysis directly demonstrates that domain-score movement need not imply every facet changes; no whole-profile trait effect activated or architecture repaired.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Corpus exposure frequency is not each person's dose. Framework/source-taxonomy references do not supply exact current lag, saturation or independent subjective-familiarity contrast.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Successful-manipulation selection does not establish all attitude interventions succeed; mixed tasks and behavior endpoints not imported.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Successful-manipulation selection, bundled techniques and incentive-confounded capability questions limit universal claims.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Keep existing fear→risk preference interpretation with its appraisal/domain qualifications; state-induction studies support direction in particular choices, not universal risk aversion.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Same state/trait split and context limits as paired fear edge; no automatic reciprocal causal chain or independent mediated contribution.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Preserve existing ease-attribution, exposure, expectation and stimulus qualifications; fluency and familiarity remain distinct.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: SRC171 URL is SRC125 review, not its named 2007 experiment; no independent source replication or universal familiarity increase.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Preserve existing attribution/expectation/feedback/domain scope; experienced ease can inform confidence without establishing accuracy.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Confidence is not calibration, and feedback or ease attribution may alter interpretation; no universal sign or causal execution magnitude added.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Retain bounded ENABLES interpretation: available resources permit, but do not compel, issue-relevant integration.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Motivation/relevance required; task score not direct measurement, ELM citation locator unresolved. No exact dose, lag or magnitude inferred.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Threatened important freedom can elicit reactance, bounded by message/population and legitimacy; experimentally assigned message is not independently randomized perceived threat.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Social-value threat alternative, bundled scripts and same-session measurements limit direct state→state identification.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Controlled ostracism exposure supports a bounded increase in perceived exclusion; exact game-aligned ratings converge in young-adult experiments.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Age-six non-detection, pseudo-random assignment in one study, short duration, demand/attribution and cultural transfer limits remain. Framework/source mismatches require later evidence completion, not new proposition.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Reuse BIO-F01 B04 revision-review-only finding: distinguish perceived load, available resources and performance under load. Psychological consultation adds no replacement.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Sleep-related task impairment is not exact load measurement; no new B04 adjudication or dose/lag inferred.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Honor norm culture-level condition can qualify insult responses; region of upbringing is not randomly assigned honor-strength exposure.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Retain bounded insult/identity-reputation interpretation for review; specify cultural unit, individual exposure and comparison before any exact revision.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: SRC286 randomizes insult, not community norm strength; northern/southern male student and reputation scope do not generalize to every identity/person.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Communal purity norms and individual moral conviction are different levels; realized exposure/internalization and target attitude must be specified.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify norm, individual exposure, attitude, temporal order and identified design; no inferred mediator or revision implementation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Tight/loose culture and dehumanization sources do not test this exact norm→conviction contrast.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Shared sacred-tradeoff prohibition is not individual conviction; selection and mutual reinforcement may explain association.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Restrict future proposal to exact prohibition/attitude/population and exposure sequence; replacement remains unimplemented.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: No independent exogenous communal-prohibition manipulation aligned to this individual endpoint.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Shame-regulation norms are distinct from national cultural tightness and an individual's shame report; country correlations do not identify within-person shame causation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Keep context-dependent semantics but require a specified norm, relevant exposure/role violation, independent shame measure and temporal design; no generic tightness→shame substitution.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Variation in culturally meaningful exposure, role, audience and self-evaluation; shame/embarrassment overlap and Western sampling limit transfer.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Cultural authority legitimacy and individual credibility are distinct levels; credential cue is not randomly assigned cultural norm.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require cultural unit, realized source exposure and separate individual profile measure/design; no automatic cross-level causal shortcut.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Shared convention may aggregate individual judgments; authority familiarity, exposure and prior belief confound direction.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Durable collective narrative centrality and an individual's multidimensional identification require realized exposure, interpretation and component specification. Current mediated-segment wording is generic, not an identified mechanism.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require exact narrative/context exposure, profile component, population/time and source-aligned identification; no shortcut or pathway implementation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Tight/loose culture and explicit dehumanization sources do not test this exact narrative→profile effect.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Ambient noise effects depend on speech/intermittency/task and performance measure; IPCC health chapter is not an exact noise→load trial.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Future scope must specify noise type/intensity/schedule, comparator and independently measured resource occupancy; no universal monotonic or performance-to-load substitution.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Noise synthesis has mixed mechanism evidence and outcome heterogeneity; impairment or masking cannot be equated with load.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Reuse INF-F03 approved revision-proposal-only finding: ambiguity and cognitive-processing demand require task/proxy alignment; no replacement implemented.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Contrary/task-specific findings and shared surface-language/complexity influences remain in protected INF-F03 package.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Framing can alter risky decisions through reference/representation; the canonical endpoint is loss-versus-gain sensitivity, not choice itself. Framework sources do not isolate a changed loss-aversion parameter.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify realized frame, reference, exact utility/choice estimand and temporal contrast; retain review of endpoint/construct mismatch without implementing replacement.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Framing synthesis is heterogeneous; reference manipulation versus salience and design differ. No universal monotonic parameter effect.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Objective methodological evidence quality is not pretested subjective argument strength.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify content-coded quality, recipient processing, independent perceived-strength measurement and context.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Strong/weak argument manipulation can define strength from recipients' responses; RDoC/COM-B sources not exact independent effect.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Traceability permits checking; discovered poor source or failure may reduce credibility.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Preserve conditional trusted-source interpretation, specify actual disclosed history/uptake and credibility dimension.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Replication-success/failure findings depend on what disclosed provenance reveals, not provenance quantity alone.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Communicated severity is distinct from perceived severity; native references are a behavior-design framework and information-threat policy, not exact trial evidence.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Scope claim content, source credibility, delivered dose and independent perceived-severity measurement. Do not infer every warning increases severity; source reconciliation required.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Risk-message vaccination synthesis has undetected severity effect; attention/belief and exposure differ.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Information about efficacy differs from belief in efficacy; original framework/policy sources do not test the exact target.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require exact truthful response-efficacy message and independent same-response PSY-010 assessment; no behavioral outcome substituted for appraisal; universal sign unverified.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Positive response-efficacy content may improve behavioral outcomes without proving the measured appraisal changed.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Material omission is RDS ratio over a reference universe; perceptual sufficiency requires recipient detection/knowledge.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: HEIGHTENED review: specify materiality universe, denominator, omitted content, awareness, temporal mechanism and independent sufficiency measure; no formula-to-perception inevitability.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Gehlbach partial-information conditions did not show lower composite adequacy; confidence could be higher. Undetected omission not perceived insufficiency.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Current mechanism describes accuracy of causal beliefs, but PSY-063 is confidence in a specified causal proposition; veracity, acceptance, strength and calibration remain distinct.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Future adjudication must distinguish strength/confidence from accuracy; specify exposed causal proposition, verified content, baseline belief, actual acceptance and subsequent confidence. No new accuracy endpoint or universal increase/decrease is proposed.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: False contingencies can be confidently endorsed; rating scales influence strength scores. Context-dependent sign does not resolve target mismatch.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: External recommendation detail and internal action-plan specificity are distinct analytic units; uptake, comprehension and opportunity are required.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require realized specified recommendation exposure, internal plan measurement, independent comparator, uptake and temporal scope; no existing replacement implemented.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Reinwand examines selected intervention-arm plan writers, not randomized specificity-to-specificity transmission; COM-B is not exact manipulation evidence.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Actual mandate scope, awareness and perceived legitimacy differ; algorithm/human monitoring identity is not scope.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify institution, surveillance dimension, perceived awareness/legitimacy and timing/design; no automatic monotonic personal threat.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Employee238 correlations and four algorithm-monitoring experiments do not identify institutional mandate scope→freedom threat.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Institutional impartiality can be experienced as procedural fairness, but current sources are governance indicators and perception regressions rather than an independently identified institution-to-person effect.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify observed/experienced impartial procedure, the procedural fairness facet, population and timing; retain all other facets unknown.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Shared fairness wording, objective/perceived mismatch, and police-package scope prevent universal causal inference.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Differential enforcement can be noticed as unfair, but differential treatment may be judged justified under relevant standards; neither source isolates this objective source.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require comparable cases, awareness, standards and precise fairness facet before a bounded directional proposal.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Legitimating beliefs, exposure visibility and group position can change interpretation; no invariant negative sign.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Information about corruption can alter trust, but real corruption prevalence, trust and legitimacy are distinct; cited sources do not establish the exact negative legitimacy claim.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require observed corruption in specified institution, independent legitimacy measure and time order; do not substitute trust or information for endpoints.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Petty versus grand informational treatments differ; no NGO-donation effect and no automatic rightfulness effect.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Attitude strength changes the consequence of valence; stronger negative attitude need not increase positive behavioral intention. Legacy record itself says moderation was flattened.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Review edge-targeted moderation of REL-PSY-001 by PSY-002; no exact replacement asserted until independent strength-dimension manipulation and intention endpoint evidence are established.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Certainty findings are conditional and not whole-profile intention effects.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Retain context-dependent sign in proposal; expectancy-value formula is not experimental causality. Outcome probability and valence must refer to the same salient outcome.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: PSY-004 may alter independently elicited PSY-001 for one specified action/outcome when outcome valuation and other salient beliefs are explicitly scoped; exclude calculated attitude indices as target evidence. RESEARCH_NEEDED.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Belief-based and global attitude measures can diverge; scaling and salience limit the product-sum model.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Outcome value is not action attitude; no causal inference from using valuation as a component of an attitude estimator.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: PSY-005 may alter independently elicited PSY-001 for the specified behavior conditional on its believed connection to that outcome; preserve context-dependent sign and exclude formula-entailment. RESEARCH_NEEDED.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Probability, alternative outcomes and reference dependence prevent universal polarity.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Ease/control and capability are not one dimension; the self-efficacy experimental meta-analysis cannot automatically validate every external-constraint PBC component.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require behavior-, context- and dimension-specific independently elicited PSY-012 before PSY-026, separate capability versus controllability/ease; no behavior shortcut or universal slope.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Measured control may share intention wording; actual ability/opportunity differs from perception.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: PSY-008 permits beneficial outcomes; a generic positive fear effect is too broad. Likelihood/threat and elicited fear must be independently distinguished.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Restrict research proposal to likelihood of a specified adverse, meaningful and sufficiently immediate outcome preceding independently rated fear; preserve severity/efficacy/relevance boundaries and unresolved magnitude.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Fear-appeal manipulations often bundle severity and susceptibility; SRC124 DOI conflicts; theoretical appraisal language is not identified mediation.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Perceived severity is distinct from fear, and strong fear messages do not isolate the severity appraisal causally.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require specified harm dimension and independently measured severity preceding fear under aligned likelihood/relevance; avoid manipulation-check-to-emotion causal shortcut.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Vaccination message synthesis detected no severity shift; not equivalence evidence or proof fear cannot change.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Protective-response usefulness can support intention; content-based meta-analysis and broad theory do not identify all latent efficacy contrasts.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Bound PSY-010 to perceived efficacy of the same protective response as PSY-026, specified threat/cost/control; require independent appraisal measure, not message coding or willingness as proxy.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Self-efficacy content and response-efficacy content behave differently; high/low threat factorial review has different estimand and overlapping components.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Specific norm perceptions can precede intentions, but assigned norm discrepancy and adolescent behavior syntheses do not establish isolated descriptive-norm→commitment effects.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Restrict to specified behavior/reference group, independently measured prevalence/frequency appraisal and later intention; retain reverse/selection and non-universal conditions.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Selection exceeded socialization in the adolescent synthesis; own behavior can shape perceived norms; reference group matters.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Perceived approval and intention are related, but broad subjective-norm manipulations can bundle descriptive/approval and personal attitudes.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify whose approval, which behavior, independent approval measure and later commitment; no approval→actual behavior shortcut.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Shared self-report/obligation wording and pressure/approval distinctions; not evidence of inevitable compliance.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Procedural-justice packages and organizational justice correlations support a research direction, not uniform causal effects of every fairness facet on rightfulness.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Limit proposed scope to named fairness facet and independently measured authority rightfulness; retain null legitimacy findings and package versus component uncertainty.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Specific policing legitimacy outcome not statistically conclusive; four of seven evaluations derive from RISE; trust/satisfaction gains are not legitimacy.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Functional perceived support can buffer stress-related outcomes, while integration measures often show main effects; these are not identical causal routes into perceived stress appraisal.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require specified available-support facet and later demand-resource appraisal; distinguish main effect from exact stressor-edge moderation, with no inferred universal buffering.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Well-being/health outcomes differ from PSY-054 appraisal; support matching and same-method bias matter.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Norm-feedback experiments can influence individual behavior, but perceived norms are not independently randomized and group prevalence requires explicit aggregation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Retain time-indexed reciprocal process RP-NORM-PREVALENCE-001; require reference-group composition/window, causal mechanism and aggregation without double-counting individual contributions.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: 2016 study offers reverse behavioral-to-perceived-norm pathway analysis too; neither direction proven by mediation regression.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Perceived rejection and low belonging share content; randomized ostracism changes both but does not independently randomize the perceived-exclusion mediator.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Retain noncausal/construct-overlap review with exact replacement unresolved; no retyping, inverse-equivalence or mediation implementation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Simultaneous inverse scores and outsider items risk construct/measurement duplication; social exposure is a different source.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Current volition-to-self-endorsed-regulation mechanism is plausible but overlapping wording and pooled SDT correlations do not isolate independent causal change.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify independently measured autonomy experience and later regulation, distinguishing internalization from simultaneous shared items and provider support.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Ng uses meta-analyzed correlations/path analysis; Reeve's option-choice manipulation did not increase volition. Neither proves all need satisfaction causes later regulation.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Competence and intrinsic interest are related, but feedback/choice manipulations affect multiple experiences rather than randomizing competence alone.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Restrict to task-specific perceived competence with independent later interest measure and autonomy/challenge conditions; resolve shape/causal-role questions before any replacement.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Positive polarity coexists with legacy inverted-U note; task interest, performance and competence subscales must not be pooled. Correlational mediator path is not identified.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Retain current NON_MONOTONIC context dependence, but review cited evidence for perceived difficulty causing commitment rather than commitment moderating difficulty-to-performance.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Keep feasibility, acceptance, goal origin and independent commitment measure explicit; no invented threshold or universal positive/negative slope.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Task difficulty is not goal difficulty; performance outcomes and self-efficacy cannot establish an inverted-U commitment response.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: The current mechanism is already inaction-qualified. Preserve it, but explicit source findings distinguish action versus inaction regret and largely associative evidence.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Represent inaction regret about specified behavior/outcome and later intention; separate action-regret direction, measurement framing and causal evidence requirements.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Action regret predicts weaker intention whereas inaction regret predicts stronger intention. Prediction beyond TPB and prospective association do not identify latent-regret causation.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: A clear goal supplies a comparison criterion, but Harkin experimentally promotes monitoring rather than identifying goal-specificity-to-monitoring intensity.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Separate clear criterion affordance from actual monitoring frequency; obtain exact manipulation/measurement and timing before a bounded replacement.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Specific+difficult goal packages and achieved performance are not isolated specificity or checking frequency; opportunity/feedback availability required.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Anxiety is associated with poorer working-memory task performance and experimentally induced anxiety can impair tasks; task capacity/performance are not the entire available-resource construct.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Bound anxiety type, task/load, compensatory effort and timing; distinguish self-reported anxiety associations from induced-state contrasts and exact PSY-058 alignment.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Moran177 samples includes mixed findings; compensatory effort may preserve effectiveness even when efficiency changes.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Occupied resources and available resources can be complementary descriptions under a fixed-capacity model; that does not establish independent temporal causation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Separate a temporally specified competing demand manipulation from contemporaneous occupied/available resource descriptions; require independent measurement and no double representation of one resource contribution.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Both canonical entities remain Drivers. Different resources/strategies or task measures can break a simple inverse; no arithmetic complement assumed.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Habit-strength composites include automaticity items and the definition already specifies reduced deliberation. Contemporaneous composite/subscale correlation cannot establish independent cause.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Future noncausal construct/measurement-overlap review under exact context, behavior and independent indicators; no exact replacement predicate or reclassification proposed.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Habit and automaticity remain distinct canonically, but shared items and lack of independent temporally ordered measures challenge the causal reading. Failed devaluation induction also cautions against treating every automatic response as acquired habit.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Stronger cue-response links may facilitate particular initiation features, but whole PSY-071 automaticity is multidimensional and may share priming/latency indicators with the source.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Future claim must specify independently measured cue-link strength, particular automaticity dimension, temporal separation and cue/goal/inhibition scope. Do not generalize rapid priming to every automaticity feature.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Efficient, rapid, unintentional and unaware responding are not equivalent; incompatible goals and inhibition can override expression. SRC120 stored title/authors/year differ from its PMID.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: An assigned if-then planning operation is not a measured increase in PSY-075 strength. Cue accessibility and cue-response association are different mediator candidates; performance does not identify both.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Future scope should separate randomized plan formation from measured implementation-intention strength, exact cue-response priming from cue salience, and immediate encoding from later durable habit. No transmitted pathway or universal effect.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Weak/inactive goal conditions showed no goal-performance benefit; measured-goal interaction not randomized moderator. Source120 bibliography and priming details need reconciliation.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Monitoring can change perceived-current information before corrective behavior. The RDS then recalculates; later progress toward a target is not the same operation. For a signed discrepancy, approach to zero is not universal NEGATIVE polarity.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Separate research questions for perception/input updating and later corrective behavior under explicit reference, sign and interval; no causal replacement or formal pathway. Recalculate RDS only, without adding formula-as-causality.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Harkin assesses monitoring and goal attainment, not a universal decrease in signed perceived discrepancy. Shared current/reference inputs and feedback can increase a revealed gap.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Emotion-regulation capacity is not habitual strategy use or instructed reappraisal. Cited dispositional psychopathology synthesis and ERQ validation do not isolate available capacity→anger.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify capacity assessment separate from chosen strategy, deployment opportunity, goal and experienced-versus-expressed anger; identify causal design and timing.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Suppression can reduce expression without reducing experienced negative emotion; a composite reappraisal result does not establish anger-specific or capacity effect.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Attention-control capacity and WM availability are related but cannot be equated with task performance; CONSTRAINS plus POSITIVE requires explicit protective-capacity interpretation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify protective control of distraction and exact available-resource measure under a task; adjudicate predicate interpretation without silently replacing current CONSTRAINS/POSITIVE semantics.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Anxiety/effort/strategy can compensate, and shared tasks inflate association; no broad trait/state or latency/accuracy equivalence.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Centrality is already a component of PSY-097 profile; same-time profile→centrality may be definitional/measurement overlap rather than independent cause.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Noncausal/component-boundary review only, replacement predicate unresolved. Do not retype, replace or deactivate current edge.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Shared items, specification and group target can induce dependence; cited culture/dehumanization sources not exact temporal component mechanism.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Global threat may promote defensive processing, but counterarguing is exact thought count/quality; affirmation→message acceptance does not identify threat→counterarguing.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Require independent threat and counterargument measures, scoped message/affirmation opportunity and timing; no guaranteed defensive thought direction from acceptance outcomes.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Health synthesis outcomes, self-compassion experiments and Senegal nulls differ; group affirmation can increase ingroup bias or have nearzero average.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Identity threat, identification, perceived injustice and anger are distinct. Collective-action meta-analyses do not isolate this exact threat→anger proposition.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.proposal: Specify threatened identity, devaluation/constraint manipulation and later experienced anger independently of collective-action/identity indicators; no universal direction or mediation.
existingRelationshipRecommendations.nullContrary: Anger, fear or withdrawal can follow depending on appraisal/efficacy/context; SRC160/SRC-501 same umbrella source.

existingRelationshipRecommendations.rationale: Person-level identification and group cooperation prevalence require contribution/opportunity aggregation, not collective-action intent or violent sacrifice.
